title: Made macro reports queryable with source pages
points: Added a dedicated `macro_documents` retrieval lane for Budget, Economic Survey, and SBP annual report questions.
Macro retrieval uses `macro_fts` BM25 over parsed table/text markdown while keeping macro separate from company filings and PSX announcements.
Macro source PDFs and thumbnails are hosted under `source.psxgpt.com/MACRO_PAGES/...` and `MACRO_THUMBNAILS/...` so answers can show clickable report pages.
The source panel now groups macro evidence separately from Statements, Filings, and Announcements.
